episodes.title: Unpacking the 'Death of the Pastors Wife'
episodes.description: With the recent release of the Netflix Documentary of the 'Death of the Pastor's Wife' discussing the tragic death of Mica Francis, we wanted to unpack what we could of this heart wrenching story. On the Mic today we are joined by our token woke bloke, Hayden Whitworth Executive Leader at Be There Group · Facilitator · Engineer. Men's Behaviour Change Specialist sharing his valued insights as a Father, Man and a Man of Faith on this harrowing story and the themes of Spiritual Abuse, Power and Control all through it. You can watch the 'Death of The Pastor's Wife' here on Netflix. Shaan's recommendation: The Empathy Gap by Daniel Murray Kirsty's recommendation: Framed by Deb Candler This podcast was recorded on the land of the Kombumerri Saltwater People of the Yugambeh speaking language. We pay our respects to elders past present and emerging.
